lang: python
file: cleanup_raise.py
---
def write_atomic(tmp_name, filename, payload):
    try:
        with open(tmp_name, "wb") as f:
            f.write(payload)
        os.replace(tmp_name, filename)
    except BaseException:
        os.remove(tmp_name)
        raise
